items.title: UK government set to publish new treaties agreed with EU
items.summary: The BBC understands the treaties contain a 10-year termination clause to reimburse costs of any need to rebuild border checks infrastructure.

items.title: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds

items.title: Watch: BBC confronts German man suspected of supplying migrant gangs with small boats

items.title: Expect fewer frosts and more hot days as UK seasons shift, says Met Office
items.summary: Changing seasons are affecting wildlife and leading some farmers to grow different crops.

items.title: BBC launches partnership with Met Office for weather coverage
items.summary: The corporation says the deal will deliver more regional, digital and 10-day forecasts to audiences.

items.title: Stalking law simplified to become one offence
items.summary: The new stalking offence will be introduced after a review found existing legislation was confusing.

items.title: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor dies aged 65
items.summary: The musician, who co-wrote some of the band's biggest hits, had been treated for prostate cancer.

items.title: US approves SpaceX plan to send a million data satellites to space
items.summary: The Starmind constellation aims to be the most cost and energy-efficient way to meet the growing demand for AI computing power.
